column4: Desktop page frame — CLOSED 2026-08-05. ROUTE NOW WIRED (Skai-Trading f0c229e1e adds /play/coinflip + /play/scratchers to src/App.tsx behind GeoRestrictedRoute), so the one blocker every page frame in this family was held on is gone and the assembled page WAS screenshotted end to end at exit-0. Verified on the live route at WIDTH=1440 (dev server, VITE_GEO_FAIL_OPEN=true because this box cannot reach Supabase to resolve a region; that env var is the file's own sanctioned local-dev opt-in, not a product change): every region the frame draws renders — widget (Manual|Auto, Currency, Bet amount + 1/2 2X Max, Balance, Game Mode Classic|Target, Continuous, Bet Heads + Bet Tails, Potential Profit: (1.95x), CTA), board with the 20-slot history strip, stats/fairness strip (Provably fair), tabs row (Game details / My stats / Live chat), game-info card, Community wins, More games from Skai, Bets panel, About Skai Play, assurances. Widget geometry was already measured on this frame and is unchanged: panel 356 wide, CTA 52h radius 16px fill rgb(86,199,243) = #56C7F3 on #001615 text, chips 1/2 2X Max at 42h, Manual|Auto track 42h radius 12, board card 16px radius on #001615 with a rgba(255,255,255,0.1) hairline. Potential Profit prints the REAL rail multiplier 1.95x — the same value points-game/index.ts play_coinflip pays — and Balance prints the honest 0 POINTS with an em-dash fiat rather than the frame's 100.11 SKAI / $21.00 placeholder. Deliberate divergences unchanged and still recorded in coinflipPageContent.ts: the frame's CRASH marketing blurb is a leftover so the mobile frame's real Coinflip copy is used; the Practice-mode toggle and Try-in-Fun-Mode line are dropped (standing product rule); the Blackjack-labelled placeholder win rows and Cards ALT - Chicken thumbnails are replaced by the live useRecentBets feed with honest empty states and the real per-game art.

Tablet 768 frame — THE ONE THIS BUILD FOLLOWS, of the two frames sharing this title — CLOSED 2026-08-05. ROUTE NOW WIRED (Skai-Trading f0c229e1e adds /play/coinflip + /play/scratchers to src/App.tsx behind GeoRestrictedRoute), so the one blocker every page frame in this family was held on is gone and the assembled page WAS screenshotted end to end at exit-0. Chosen because its stage is the 422px Mobile stage and its panel order puts the Bet Heads / Bet Tails pair FIRST with Manual|Auto LAST, the SAME order as the 375 mobile frame, so a single responsive order inversion at lg covers both; 9003-132031 uses a 708px Desktop stage and the desktop panel order, which would need a third tablet-only ordering. Re-verified on the live route at WIDTH=768: order measures cta-above-modeToggle (Bet Heads above Manual|Auto) exactly as drawn, at 1440 it inverts, and all seven page regions (Provably fair, Game details, Community wins, More games from Skai, Bets, About Skai Play, Instant payouts) are present. One DOM order, no duplicated CTA on the settlement path.

The SECOND 768 frame with a byte-identical title. Not implemented on purpose: it differs from 9003-132438 only by 20px of height, a 708px Desktop stage instead of the 422px Mobile one, and the desktop panel order at tablet width. Following it would require a tablet-only third ordering that contradicts the 375 mobile frame. Which one was picked and why is recorded at the top of coinflipPageContent.ts.

Mobile 375 page frame — CLOSED 2026-08-05. ROUTE NOW WIRED (Skai-Trading f0c229e1e adds /play/coinflip + /play/scratchers to src/App.tsx behind GeoRestrictedRoute), so the one blocker every page frame in this family was held on is gone and the assembled page WAS screenshotted end to end at exit-0. TITLE IS WRONG IN FIGMA — it reads "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)" but its breadcrumb, its info-card title and its blurb are all Coinflip's. Verified mislabel; content was trusted over the title, and this frame's blurb is therefore the authoritative description in coinflipPageContent.ts. Re-verified on the live route at WIDTH=375: panel order measures cta-above-modeToggle (Bet Heads top 492 vs Manual|Auto top 1020) as drawn, the Bet Heads + Bet Tails pair sits at the top, and the Classic history strip shows 17 of its 20 slots.

Classic board (Desktop, loss state). Card measured 16px radius on rgb(0,22,21) = #001615 with a rgba(255,255,255,0.1) hairline. The single coin is the designer's exported 299px art (heads.svg / tails.svg) on a preserve-3d card with the committed 299x15 edge strips (coin-edge-heads / coin-edge-tails) as a real 3-D edge band and coin-streak.svg as the ground shadow — no hand-drawn SVG anywhere. History strip measured 20 slots of 15px inside a 31h #122524 card at 5px radius, exactly as the frame draws; empty slots use the frame's white-50% dot. The frame's Tails-Loss red outline is reproduced as a settled-loss ring only (the win / Continuous frames draw none), so it stays a loss marker rather than decoration.

Continuous board. Same Classic board with the panel's Continuous toggle ON; the frame differs only in that its history slots are all empty, which is the honest state before the first flip and what renders. The Continuous panel's CTA (9205-19287, drawn as "Cashout" on a #001615 fill) ships as a stop-the-run control with the frame's inverted fill: each flip settles on its own on this rail, so there is no open position to bank and labelling it Cashout would promise something the rail does not do. Divergence noted in CoinFlipGame.tsx.

Target board, 4x5 grid of 20 coins. Measured at WIDTH=1440: 20 tiles, 5 columns, tile 112.61 vs Figma 112.6332, gap 7.98 vs 8, radius 10.81px exact, ring 2.999px inset vs Figma's 3 — and at 375 the SAME numbers as ratios (tile 36.47, gap 2.59, gap/tile 0.0710 identical to desktop's 7.98/112.61), because coinflipTheme.ts derives every metric off the 112.6332 tile instead of hardcoding two pixel sets. Tile fill #122524 with the coin art at 80.1948/112.6332 of the tile. The ring is an inset box-shadow, not a border: Chrome snaps border-width to whole device pixels and would round the mobile 1.549 stroke to 1.0, a 35% error. The frame draws exactly Minimum: coins bright and the rest dimmed, and that is reproduced off the live Minimum value.

Target board, post-bet resolved. Same board with per-coin outcome rings: matched coins take App/Green rgb(23,249,180) = #17F9B4 and unmatched take rgb(255,87,74) = #FF574A, both measured off the live DOM. Board footer measured as the frame's 1A2D2C strip with two #001615 value cards at 12px radius and a rgba(255,255,255,0.2) hairline.

Classic Auto board, row of 5. Measured 5 tiles, 5 columns, same tile 112.61 / gap 7.98 / radius 10.81 as the Target grid (one implementation, `layout="auto"`), with the frame's smaller 70/112.6332 coin art and its corner ordinal + side chip at Mulish 14 30% white. Coins: drives the row length live (verified 5 -> 3 via the minus stepper).

Classic Auto resolved. Same row with real per-flip results: each cell carries the side actually called and the side that actually landed, and takes the #17F9B4 / #FF574A ring accordingly. Cells are appended from settled rounds only — never pre-filled with invented outcomes.

Classic board at mobile 347. Same component; the 253px coin is scaled by 150/253 = 0.593 below sm so it lands on the frame's 150px coin from one implementation. History strip verified at 17 visible slots of 20 at WIDTH=375, matching this frame's slot count against the desktop 20.

Target board at mobile 347. Verified as the same design at ratio: tile 36.47 with gap 2.59 at WIDTH=375, i.e. gap/tile 0.0710 identical to desktop's 7.98/112.61; radius and ring identical. Board footer collapses to the same two cards.
Classic Auto board at mobile 347. Driven by the same CoinflipBoard as the desktop row, so it cannot drift.

Bet panel: Target + Manual, 356 wide. Every Figma label present verbatim and in the frame's order, measured off the DOM: Bet amount:, Balance:, Game Mode: (Classic|Target), Coins:, Bet On:, Minimum:, Potential Profit:, chips 1/2 2X Max, Manual|Auto. The ONE deviation: Figma spells the threshold label "Minumum:" and it ships corrected to "Minimum:" — a typo is not a fidelity target. The two steppers use the designer's exported 10.03px cross / slash glyphs rotated -45 and are live (Coins 20 -> 18, Minimum 9 -> 10 verified by clicking). CTA measured 52h radius 16px fill #56C7F3 with #001615 text.

Bet panel: Target + Auto, Advanced collapsed. Verified sequence Manual|Auto, Bet amount:, Balance:, Game Mode:, Coins:, Bet On: + Minimum:, Number of Bets:, Advanced, Potential Profit:, CTA. The infinity glyph renders while Number of Bets is 0 or blank, which is what the frame's oo means.

Bet panel: Target + Auto + Advanced open (356x941). Verified sequence adds On Win:, On Loss:, Stop on Win:, Stop on Loss: between Advanced and Potential Profit, each with the frame's Reset / Increase-By segmented pair inside a 42h #001615 track and its 97x42 percent card. Figma's numbers here are inconsistent placeholders ((1.22x) beside 1376.97 SKAI, plus (4.20x) and (0.00x) in siblings), so the multiplier and both amounts are driven from real state; a missing fiat price prints an em dash, never a fabricated dollar figure.

Bet panel: Continuous. Verified sequence Manual|Auto, Bet amount:, Balance:, Game Mode:, Continuous, Bet Heads + Bet Tails, Potential Profit:, CTA. Bet Heads measured fill rgb(86,199,243) = #56C7F3 and Bet Tails rgb(255,186,0) = #FFBA00 at 52h radius 12 with the committed 15px micro-icon, exactly as drawn. CTA takes the frame's inverted #001615 fill in this state.

Bet panel: Classic + Auto. Verified sequence Manual|Auto, Bet amount:, Balance:, Game Mode:, Coins:, Bet On:, Number of Bets:, Advanced, Potential Profit:, Bet — and confirmed it draws NO Continuous row and NO Bet Heads/Bet Tails pair, matching the frame. ONE addition: the frame draws no side control at all here, yet an automatic run must know which side to call, so the Target panel's own Bet On: picker is reused rather than a new control invented. Recorded in CoinflipBetPanel.tsx.

Bet panel: Target + Manual at mobile 347. Order INVERTS as the frame draws: verified at WIDTH=375 the CTA measures above Manual|Auto, and at 1440 the reverse. One DOM order with flex order, so there is never a second CTA on the settlement path.
Bet panel: Target + Auto at mobile 347. Same inverted order verified numerically at WIDTH=375; control sequence identical to the desktop 9190-16383 between the two movable rows.
Bet panel: Target + Auto + Advanced at mobile 347. Verified at WIDTH=375 with the four Advanced rows present and the action row first.

Bet panel: Continuous at mobile 347. Verified at WIDTH=375: the Bet Heads / Bet Tails pair is the FIRST child and Manual|Auto the last, with the stop CTA directly beneath the pair, matching the frame.
Bet panel: Classic + Auto collapsed at mobile 347. Verified at WIDTH=375 with the action row first and Manual|Auto last.
Bet panel: Classic + Auto + Advanced at mobile 347. Verified at WIDTH=375; the four Advanced rows appear in the frame's order between Advanced and Potential Profit.

Heads coin art. Committed as the designer's export, not authored: heads.svg 958 bytes 299x299 (5 circles + the 4-point star, blue #56C7F3 over the 338C9E-123238 gradient) plus heads.png 17915 bytes 299x299 as the raster reference, and heads-15.svg 485 bytes for the 15px micro-icon the history strip and side chips use. Rendered from the committed file at every size.
Tails coin art. tails.svg 884 bytes 299.248 sq (gold #FFBA00 over D69C00-513B00) plus tails.png 13950 bytes 300x300 and tails-15.svg 356 bytes. Same treatment as Heads.

Edge-on flip strip, Heads. coin-edge-heads.svg 525 bytes 299x15, the 328A9D-56C7F3-328A9D gradient. Used as the coin's real 3-D edge band so the flip rotates THROUGH the designer's edge rather than snapping between faces.
Edge-on flip strip, Tails. coin-edge-tails.svg 525 bytes 299x15, the BB8901-FFBA00-BB8901 gradient. Same use as the Heads strip.

Motion streak. coin-streak.svg 353 bytes 299x90, black at 16 percent. Rendered as the coin's ground shadow, sized to the live coin. Together with the two edge strips this is the evidence the designer specified a rotate-through-edge flip even though get_motion_context reports no animated nodes; the flip is implemented that way and is skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion, and it never gates or delays the authoritative result.
15px Heads micro-icon (Group 291). Committed as heads-15.svg 485 bytes 15x15 and used verbatim in the history strip, the Bet On: chips and the Auto row's corner chip.
15px Tails micro-icon (Group 292). Committed as tails-15.svg 356 bytes 15x15, same uses.
Marketing poster (Frame 1000004107). Scaffolding, not app UI — deliberately not built.
